correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and any nonempty finite integer shift set H, the local criterion z regular in Z/p^a iff z is a unit or zero mod p^a is proved: p|z with 0<v_p(z)<a makes z(zy-1) have valuation v_p(z), which cannot vanish mod p^a. Partition starting residues x mod p by whether an occupied shift class c satisfies x+c=0: p-r_p(H) unobstructed classes have p^(a-1) successful lifts, and each occupied class contributes one lift iff all its shifts coincide mod p^a. Chinese remaindering gives the product for C_n(H). For H={0,...,L-1}, exact occupied multiplicities yield the p,p-L and 2p-L piecewise factors, including p and 2p boundary overlaps; nonsquarefree minimal squared-prime q determines maximal length 2q-1 and B_n(2q-1)>0. Double indicator inclusion-exclusion gives exact bounded cyclic run histogram E_n(L)=B_n(L)-2B_n(L+1)+B_n(L+2). Squarefree moduli are explicitly excluded from bounded-run statement. Independent fresh exact-integer residue counting agreed with the product on 714 cases for n=2..120 and six diverse shift sets per modulus. The original verify.py was inspected, not assumed to certify infinity.
